description: Original bilingual educational test definitions; not clinical protocols.

tests.help_zh: 陽性：紫色；陰性：粉紅色。先確認菌落是否為純培養。
tests.help_en: Gram-positive (purple) or Gram-negative (pink); verify a pure isolate.

tests.help_zh: 球菌或桿菌。實際顯微形態可能受菌齡和條件影響。
tests.help_en: Coccus or rod; actual appearance depends on culture conditions.

tests.help_zh: 葡萄串／鏈狀／單個或不規則；並非所有菌種都有固定排列。
tests.help_en: Clusters, chains or single/irregular; arrangement is not definitive.

tests.help_zh: 過氧化氫產生氣泡為陽性。可先區分常見葡萄球菌與鏈球菌／腸球菌。
tests.help_en: Bubble production; helps distinguish staphylococci from streptococci/enterococci.

tests.help_zh: 經典凝固酶反應，可輔助鑑別 S. aureus 與典型凝固酶陰性葡萄球菌。
tests.help_en: Classic coagulase test supporting S. aureus vs coagulase-negative staphylococci.

tests.help_zh: 氧化酶試驗有助於區分部分革蘭氏陰性桿菌；須按規定時間判讀。
tests.help_en: Differentiates certain Gram-negative rods; read within the validated time.

tests.help_zh: 以色胺酸酶產生吲哚；可用於常見腸道菌的生化鑑別。
tests.help_en: Tryptophan metabolism to indole; useful for selected enteric bacteria.

tests.help_zh: 尿素水解使培養基鹼化；陽性速度與菌株、培養時間相關。
tests.help_en: Urea hydrolysis increases pH; rate varies with strain and incubation.

tests.help_zh: 如 MacConkey 乳糖發酵反應。延遲或弱反應可能影響判讀。
tests.help_en: E.g. MacConkey lactose fermentation; delayed/weak reactions may differ.

tests.help_zh: 檸檬酸鹽利用試驗需配合適當培養條件與接種量。
tests.help_en: Citrate use must be read under appropriate medium and inoculum conditions.

tests.help_zh: 運動性試驗可能因溫度、培養基及菌株而不同。
tests.help_en: Motility can vary with temperature, medium and isolate.

tests.help_zh: 如 TSI／SIM 的黑色沉澱；反應可能因培養時間與菌株而異。
tests.help_en: Blackening in TSI/SIM; may vary with strain and culture time.

tests.help_zh: 膽汁七葉苷試驗可輔助腸球菌與部分鏈球菌群的鑑別。
tests.help_en: Helps distinguish enterococci and selected streptococcal groups.

tests.help_zh: PYR 水解反應常見於 E. faecalis 與 S. pyogenes，仍需其他試驗區分。
tests.help_en: PYR can be positive in E. faecalis and S. pyogenes; not sufficient alone.
